Framing: the front wheel and cab on the left half, the rear wheel at about x 640, y 800 of 1080×1920, about 300 px in diameter; behind the truck a soft-focus apartment block with poplars; plain clean paving below. No text, no plates, no logos, no numbers. From the object sheet use only the truck and the parcel; ignore the small worker figures in hi-vis vests on it and never draw them. Handmade needle-felted wool miniature diorama photographed with a tilt-shift macro lens: soft visible wool fibres, matte card and painted-wood props, dignified adult felt-doll figures with simple stitched faces, narrow sharp focus band with strong soft blur at top and bottom, soft diffused light with gentle bloom, lifted shadows and creamy highlights, muted palette of cream #F6F1E4, sand #ECE6D6 and kiwi-brown #7A5A3C with ink-dark #111410 details and only tiny lime #B8F03C accents; every surface plain and unbranded — no text, no letters, no numbers, no signage, no logos. Use the attached reference images only to keep the identity, proportions, clothing and material of the characters and objects; do not copy their sheet layout, panels or plain background. One single continuous photograph, no panels, no borders. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage or labels anywhere, including on the parcels, phone, clothing, walls, doors and vehicles. Hands simple with five fingers, faces calm and undistorted. No yurt, no tunduk, no flags, no emblems.
jobs.qa_notes: Same failure: hi-vis worker dolls + undersized truck (rear wheel ~140 px at ~x515,y1100). Kept as best-of-fail reference for the truck look only.
